description: Topics: stories, conversation-containers, agent-defaults, boundaries, search, essays, domains. The owner asked that the narrative-explorations practice be default for every agent and set the standard: one container per chat, yyyy-mm-dd title, agent-kept summary, tags on the identity note. Containers are boundaries (find --container already bounds content search; the rest is srs#973). Then the essay process: an essay is a container for meaning that grows from exploration to argument, kept as notes apart from the records that emerge, cloned into families under domains. Filed: srs#973, srs-web#623-626, muDemocracy.org#392. Done: handbook chapter updated, brief convention sharpened, sub-repo CLAUDE.md pointers.
